en: The image shows an old postcard with Russian writing, a red imperial Russian double-headed eagle emblem, and a postage stamp with a similar emblem. There are two postmarks, one of which clearly reads 'С.-ПЕТЕРБУРГЪ' (St. Petersburg) and is dated '14 XI 1902'. The text is handwritten in Cyrillic script, and the card is addressed to an individual. The printed text at the top reads 'ОТКРЫТОЕ ПИСЬМО' (Open Letter/Postcard) in Russian.
